levels.technical:
Under Hypothesis (S), $T = v_{1}v_{2}v_{3}v_{4}v_{5}$ sends the empty state $
u^{c}$ to the full state and annihilates every other state, so the mass form $B(\psi, T\varphi)$ on the sixteen has only the $
u^{c}
u^{c}$ entry: a Majorana mass for the right-handed neutrino. $T$ commutes with $\su(3)$, $\su(2)_{L}$ and $Y$, with $[B - L, T] = -2T$; inside the real span of the $21$ Pati-Salam generators its stabiliser is exactly the twelve-dimensional $\su(3) \oplus \su(2)_{L} \oplus \uu(1)_{Y}$, and its orbit spans the thirty-dimensional $(10,1,3)$.

So a vev along $T$ breaks Pati-Salam to the Standard Model algebra and gives $
u^{c}$ its Majorana mass at the same scale. It also breaks the thirteenth generator, which lies in $\su(2)_{R} \oplus \su(4)$ as $X = 2T_{3R} - 	frac32(B - L)$.
levels.lay: Assuming the slots behave like the pairs (Hypothesis (S)), a particular element built from all five creation operators turns the empty state, the right-handed neutrino, into the completely filled state and does nothing else. Used as a mass term it gives only the right-handed neutrino a mass, of the kind a neutral particle can have on its own. Among the Pati-Salam symmetries, those that leave the element unchanged are exactly those of the Standard Model, so a background value along it breaks the larger Pati-Salam symmetry to the Standard Model and gives that neutrino its mass at the same energy.
levels.one-liner: Under Hypothesis (S), the product of the five creation operators spans the $(10,1,3)$ under Pati-Salam, gives only $\nu^{c}$ a Majorana mass, and is fixed by exactly the Standard Model algebra.

proofs.main: (1) to (3) are computations on the module, whose sectors are the species of the generation under (S) (\claimref{standard-model.hyp-s-slot-statistics}), in the script; for (2) it finds that $X \mapsto [X, T]$ has rank nine on the real span of the $21$, and that the compact forms of $\su(3)$, $\su(2)_{L}$ and $Y$, twelve dimensions, annihilate $T$. The statement about the form in (1) follows because $B$ pairs each occupation state with its complement (\claimref{standard-model.invariant-pairing-five-modes}). The expression for $X$ follows from $X = 2Y - \tfrac52(B - L)$ (\claimref{standard-model.under-s-composites-state-space-spinor}(3)) and Proposition \claimref{standard-model.automorphisms-preserve-slot-pair-split-are}'s $Y = T_{3R} + \tfrac12(B - L)$, and the script checks it species by species.
